SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account AS a JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district AS dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id WHERE dis.A3 = 'Východní Čechy' AND a.frequency LIKE '%POPLATEK PO OBRATU%'"

SELECT d.A2, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

SELECT T3.year , CAST(SUM(REPLACE(T1.time , ':','') AS INTEGER) / COUNT(*) AS REAL) FROM results AS T1 JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId JOIN seasons AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year WHERE T1.position = 1 AND T3.year < 1975 GROUP BY T3.year

SELECT T3.points, T3.name, T3.nationality 
FROM races AS T1 
JOIN constructorResults AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId 
JOIN constructors AS T3 ON T2.constructorId = T3.constructorId 
WHERE T1.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND T1.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 
ORDER BY T3.points DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.`First Date`, P.Admission, P.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE P.Admission = '-' AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0
